scope: Installed native TUI with local scripted provider; selected data-entry/lifecycle cases, not live-model or full certification

multilineUnicode.detail: Bracket-paste into actual native editor; compared normalized human text, not echoed terminal

textRead.detail: Actual file tool result retains known UTF-8 text

toolError.detail: Actual failed native read and linked result; scripted provider observed native error response

imageReference.detail: Actual native Read image output; user editor image-paste entry is a separate unverified case

userImageEntry.detail: Native editor @image entry and provider input observed; human/context attachment retains a reference, not bytes

noUnrecognized.detail: Unknown native records across initial and resumed turns stay explicit

resume.detail: Exited and relaunched native continue/resume; new typed turn remains in original stream

backfill.detail: Both manual imports compared against automatic complete native ledger

exclusions: text-file editor attachment (native UTF-8 tool read is covered)
